title: Salt & Solace | KEY.co
description_expanded: Salt & Solace is a showstopping escape in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach, crafted for elevated group getaways along Florida’s iconic 30A. Just minutes from the emerald shoreline, this modern coastal retreat combines high-end design with effortless indoor-outdoor living. The private backyard is a true oasis, featuring a sparkling pool, oversized hot tub, shaded lounging areas, and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen with TVs—perfect for al fresco dining and unwinding after sun-filled beach days. Multiple patios invite guests to relax and reconnect, with evening cocktails and Gulf breezes setting the tone for unforgettable nights. Inside, refined comfort meets relaxed coastal style across expansive open living areas. A gourmet kitchen anchors the home with premium appliances, bar seating, and a cozy breakfast nook, while the formal dining space offers a stunning setting for shared meals. Five king suites deliver serene luxury, each with a spa-inspired ensuite, while built-in bunk nooks add flexible space for kids or extra guests. With two full laundry rooms, ample parking, and every thoughtful detail in place, Salt & Solace offers an effortless, luxurious experience designed to bring everyone together in style.
